title: agentskills.io SKILL.md frontmatter
description: JSON Schema for the YAML frontmatter of a SKILL.md file per the agentskills.io open Agent Skills standard. Only `name` and `description` are required; `license`, `compatibility`, `metadata`, and `allowed-tools` are recognized optional fields. Additional top-level keys are permitted as extra metadata (this repo carries safety, paths, and frameworks), so additionalProperties is true. Two constraints JSON Schema cannot express (name must equal the parent directory; no angle brackets in frontmatter string values) are enforced by scripts/check-agentskills.sh.

name.description: 1-64 chars, lowercase alphanumeric and single hyphens only; no leading/trailing/consecutive hyphens; must equal the parent directory name; must not contain a reserved vendor word (anthropic, claude).

description.description: 1-1024 chars, stating both what the skill does and when to use it.

license.description: SPDX license identifier or license text.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key/value map for non-standard fields (version, author, category, updated).

allowed-tools.description: Tools the skill is permitted to use; string or array of strings.
